summary_en: 4,630,700 shares (7.61% of S/O) to be acquired for ¥2,167.17M via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-03 at 468 yen/share. Execution window: single trading session at 08:45 JST. Triggered by primary shareholder (Image Frame Investment HK Limited) intention to sell holdings; aims to mitigate market impact and stabilize long-term shareholder composition.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-hours trading transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On 2026-07-31, Marvelous Inc. resolved via board decision to acquire 4,630,700 treasury shares (7.61% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥2,167.17M via a single ToSTNeT-3 block transaction on 2026-08-03 at 08:45 JST, at the closing price of 468 yen per share.

The acquisition is triggered by notice from primary shareholder Image Frame Investment (HK) Limited of its intention to sell a portion of its Marvelous holdings. The company states the buyback is designed to mitigate market impact from the shareholder's disposition and to stabilize long-term shareholder composition. The company is combining this share acquisition with a separate cash-settled forward contract (announced the same day) as part of a broader capital policy framework intended to improve capital efficiency and shareholder value.

Execution is a single off-hours trading order (ToSTNeT-3) at market open on 2026-08-03; results will be announced immediately after the 08:45 trading session closes. There is no guarantee that the full authorized volume will be executed, as the order is contingent on sell-side interest at that specific time.
